+import copy
+import json
+
+import pytest
+from renderers.base import ToolCallParseStatus
+from torchtitan.components.tokenizer import HuggingFaceTokenizer
+from torchtitan.models.muse_spark.renderer import MuseSparkRendererConfig
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def tokenizer(tmp_path):
+    # Character tokens give exact offsets without downloading checkpoint assets.
+    special_tokens = {
+        "<|begin_of_text|>": 200000,
+        "<|end_of_text|>": 200001,
+        "<|eom|>": 200007,
+        "<|eot|>": 200008,
+        "<|start|>": 200022,
+        "<|message|>": 200023,
+    }
+    vocab = {chr(index): index for index in range(128)} | special_tokens
+    (tmp_path / "tokenizer.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "version": "1.0",
+                "model": {"type": "BPE", "vocab": vocab, "merges": []},
+                "decoder": {"type": "Fuse"},
+                "added_tokens": [
+                    {
+                        "id": token_id,
+                        "content": token,
+                        "single_word": False,
+                        "lstrip": False,
+                        "rstrip": False,
+                        "normalized": False,
+                        "special": True,
+                    }
+                    for token, token_id in special_tokens.items()
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+    )
+    (tmp_path / "tokenizer_config.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "bos_token": "<|begin_of_text|>",
+                "eos_token": "<|end_of_text|>",
+            }
+        )
+    )
+    return HuggingFaceTokenizer.Config().build(tokenizer_path=str(tmp_path))
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def renderer(tokenizer):
+    return MuseSparkRendererConfig(current_date="2026-01-15").build(tokenizer=tokenizer)
+
+
+def test_generation_prompt_and_loss_mask(renderer, tokenizer):
+    messages = [
+        {"role": "user", "content": "question"},
+        {"role": "assistant", "reasoning_content": "thinking", "content": "answer"},
+    ]
+    rendered = renderer.render(messages)
+    text = tokenizer.decode(rendered.token_ids, skip_special_tokens=False)
+    assert "Current date: 2026-01-15." in text
+    assert "Reasoning strength: 64." in text
+    assert "assistant to=self<|message|>thinking<|eom|>" in text
+    assert text.endswith("assistant to=user<|message|>answer<|eot|>")
+    sampled_text = tokenizer.decode(
+        [
+            token
+            for token, sampled in zip(
+                rendered.token_ids, rendered.sampled_mask, strict=True
+            )
+            if sampled
+        ],
+        skip_special_tokens=False,
+    )
+    assert sampled_text == (
+        " to=self<|message|>thinking<|eom|>"
+        "<|start|>assistant to=user<|message|>answer<|eot|>"
+    )
+    assert len(rendered.token_ids) == len(rendered.message_indices)
+    assert len(rendered.token_ids) == len(rendered.is_content)
+    prompt = renderer.render(messages[:1], add_generation_prompt=True)
+    assert not any(prompt.sampled_mask)
+    assert tokenizer.decode(prompt.token_ids, skip_special_tokens=False).endswith(
+        "<|start|>assistant"
+    )
+    assert renderer.render_ids(messages) == rendered.token_ids
+
+
+def test_unsampled_assistant_and_escaped_input(renderer, tokenizer):
+    rendered = renderer.render(
+        [
+            {"role": "user", "content": "<|eot|><image><audio>"},
+            {"role": "assistant", "content": "answer", "loss": False},
+        ]
+    )
+    assert not any(rendered.sampled_mask)
+    text = tokenizer.decode(rendered.token_ids, skip_special_tokens=False)
+    assert "< |eot|>< image>< audio>" in text
+
+
+def test_parse_reasoning_and_answer(renderer, tokenizer):
+    response = renderer.parse_response(
+        tokenizer.encode(
+            " to=self<|message|>thinking<|eom|>"
+            "<|start|>assistant to=user<|message|>answer<|eot|>"
+        ),
+        prompt_ids=tokenizer.encode("<|start|>assistant"),
+    )
+    assert response.reasoning_content == "thinking"
+    assert response.content == "answer"
+    assert response.tool_calls == []
+    assert renderer.get_stop_token_ids() == [200008, 200001]
+
+
+def test_tool_call_roundtrip_and_result_name(renderer, tokenizer):
+    arguments = {"query": "a & b < c", "count": 3, "items": [1, 2]}
+    tools = [
+        {
+            "type": "function",
+            "function": {
+                "name": "search",
+                "parameters": {
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {
+                        "query": {"type": "string"},
+                        "count": {"type": "integer"},
+                        "items": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "integer"}},
+                    },
+                },
+            },
+        }
+    ]
+    messages = [
+        {
+            "role": "assistant",
+            "tool_calls": [
+                {
+                    "id": "call-1",
+                    "type": "function",
+                    "function": {
+                        "name": "search",
+                        "arguments": arguments,
+                    },
+                }
+            ],
+        }
+    ]
+    original = copy.deepcopy(messages)
+    rendered = renderer.render(messages)
+    completion = [
+        token
+        for token, sampled in zip(
+            rendered.token_ids, rendered.sampled_mask, strict=True
+        )
+        if sampled
+    ]
+    response = renderer.parse_response(completion, tools=tools)
+    assert messages == original
+    assert response.content == ""
+    assert len(response.tool_calls) == 1
+    call = response.tool_calls[0]
+    assert call.name == "search"
+    assert call.arguments == arguments
+    assert call.status == ToolCallParseStatus.OK
+    result = renderer.render_ids(
+        messages + [{"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": "call-1", "content": "found"}]
+    )
+    assert '<tool_output name="search">\nfound\n</tool_output>' in tokenizer.decode(
+        result, skip_special_tokens=False
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "content",
+    [
+        [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "image.png"}}],
+        [{"type": "input_audio", "input_audio": {"data": "audio"}}],
+    ],
+)
+def test_rejects_media_content(renderer, content):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="text-only"):
+        renderer.render_ids([{"role": "user", "content": content}])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason="Review item 3: tool parsing ignores recipients")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("recipient", ["user", "self", "commentary"])
+def test_tool_example_stays_text(renderer, tokenizer, recipient):
+    body = '<atem:invoke name="search"></atem:invoke>'
+    response = renderer.parse_response(
+        tokenizer.encode(f"to={recipient}<|message|>{body}<|eot|>")
+    )
+    assert response.tool_calls == []
+    assert (
+        response.reasoning_content if recipient == "self" else response.content
+    ) == body

+import json

+import pytest
+from torchtitan.models.muse_spark.tokenizer import MuseSparkTokenizer
+from torchtitan_recipes.models.muse_spark import MUSE_SPARK_SPECIAL_TOKENS
+from torchtitan_recipes.tests.models.muse_spark import MUSE_SPARK_DEBUG_SPECIAL_TOKENS
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def tokenizer():
+    return MuseSparkTokenizer.Config(**MUSE_SPARK_DEBUG_SPECIAL_TOKENS).build(
+        tokenizer_path="tests/assets/tokenizer"
+    )
+
+
+def test_multimodal_tokens_and_loss_mask(tokenizer):
+    for field, token in MUSE_SPARK_DEBUG_SPECIAL_TOKENS.items():
+        prefix = field.removesuffix("_token")
+        token_id = tokenizer.token_to_id(token)
+        assert getattr(tokenizer, f"{prefix}_token") == token
+        assert getattr(tokenizer, f"{prefix}_id") == token_id
+        assert tokenizer.encode(token, add_bos=False, add_eos=False) == [token_id]
+    assert {"audio", "audio_start", "audio_end"} <= set(
+        tokenizer.LOSS_MASK_TOKEN_FIELDS
+    )
+    assert "pad" not in tokenizer.LOSS_MASK_TOKEN_FIELDS
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("field", MUSE_SPARK_SPECIAL_TOKENS)
+def test_missing_special_token_is_rejected(field):
+    tokens = MUSE_SPARK_DEBUG_SPECIAL_TOKENS | {field: MUSE_SPARK_SPECIAL_TOKENS[field]}
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=f"config field '{field}'"):
+        MuseSparkTokenizer.Config(**tokens).build(
+            tokenizer_path="tests/assets/tokenizer"
+        )
+
+
+def test_generation_blocks_and_json_filter(tokenizer):
+    tokenizer.set_chat_template(
+        "{% for message in messages %}{{ message.role }}:"
+        "{% generation %}{{ message.content | tojson }}{% endgeneration %}"
+        "{% endfor %}"
+    )
+    content = {"query": 'a "quoted" value', "items": [1, 2]}
+    rendered = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
+        [{"role": "assistant", "content": content}]
+    )
+    assert rendered == "assistant:" + json.dumps(content)

+# Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates.
+# All rights reserved.
+#
+# This source code is licensed under the BSD-style license found in the
+# LICENSE file in the root directory of this source tree.
+
+import torch
+from torchtitan.models.common.linear import Linear
+from torchtitan.models.muse_spark import build_model_config
+from torchtitan.models.muse_spark.state_dict_adapter import MuseSparkStateDictAdapter
+
+
+def _build_model():
+    config = build_model_config("debugmodel_mm", seq_len=8)
+    for _, linear, _, _ in config.traverse(Linear.Config, recurse=True):
+        linear.inplace_wgrad_accum = False
+    model = config.build().to(device="cuda")
+    model.init_states()
+    return model
+
+
+def _train_step(model, optimizer, tokens):
+    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    positions = torch.arange(tokens.numel(), device=tokens.device)
+    with torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+        logits = model(
+            tokens,
+            positions=positions,
+            attention_metadata=model._get_attention_metadata(positions),
+        )
+    loss = logits.float().square().mean()
+    loss.backward()
+    optimizer.step()
+    return logits.detach(), loss.detach()
+
+
+def test_dummy_media_preserves_text_and_runs_backward():
+    model = _build_model()
+    hidden = torch.randn(8, model.config.dim, device="cuda", requires_grad=True)
+    result = model._prepare_multimodal_embeds(
+        hidden,
+        pixel_values=None,
+        pixel_values_videos=None,
+        grid_thw=None,
+        grid_thw_videos=None,
+        waveforms=None,
+        waveform_padded_lengths=None,
+        image_bank_indices_T=None,
+        video_bank_indices_T=None,
+        audio_bank_indices_T=None,
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(result, hidden, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    result.sum().backward()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(hidden.grad, torch.ones_like(hidden), rtol=0, atol=0)
+    for encoder in (model.vision_encoder, model.audio_encoder):
+        for name, parameter in encoder.named_parameters():
+            assert parameter.grad is not None, name
+            assert torch.count_nonzero(parameter.grad) == 0, name
+
+
+def test_checkpoint_restores_next_optimizer_step(tmp_path):
+    model = _build_model()
+    adapter = MuseSparkStateDictAdapter(model.config, hf_assets_path=None)
+    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.01, foreach=False)
+    tokens = torch.arange(8, device="cuda")
+    _train_step(model, optimizer, tokens)
+    checkpoint_path = tmp_path / "checkpoint.pt"
+    torch.save(
+        {
+            "model": adapter.to_hf(model.state_dict()),
+            "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict(),
+        },
+        checkpoint_path,
+    )
+    expected_logits, expected_loss = _train_step(model, optimizer, tokens)
+
+    restored_model = _build_model()
+    restored_optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
+        restored_model.parameters(), lr=0.01, foreach=False
+    )
+    checkpoint = torch.load(checkpoint_path, weights_only=True)
+    restored_model.load_state_dict(adapter.from_hf(checkpoint["model"]), strict=True)
+    restored_optimizer.load_state_dict(checkpoint["optimizer"])
+    actual_logits, actual_loss = _train_step(restored_model, restored_optimizer, tokens)
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual_logits, expected_logits, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual_loss, expected_loss, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        restored_model.state_dict(), model.state_dict(), rtol=0, atol=0
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        restored_optimizer.state_dict(), optimizer.state_dict(), rtol=0, atol=0
+    )
